behavior: Front reaches and anchors while the capsule waits on the lower tread.
During native capsule transfer, front remains on the upper tread, rear remains below, and middle controls adhere to the sampled riser.
Rear pulls beyond the riser onto the upper tread, then the body gathers before starting the next reach.

timing.transfer: ends at native capsule upper-tread height

notes: World anchors deform the authored rig only; Ammo moves the capsule. Closed door verified after three completed tread cycles. Rejected an extra settle-position gate that could stall against the closed leaf.
